reviewers.method: Read-only numerical/descriptor/resource/axis/units/JSON/generation review plus independently derived boundary tests.
Seeded direct O(L²) DFT/windowed Parseval and raw-time/one-frame oracle comparisons.

findings.problem: Whole-grid tolerance accepted timestamp roundoff that per-frame endpoint revalidation rejected.
findings.correction: Validate one whole grid; N>L, including one retained frame with discarded tail, uses sample-index FFT and common global fs/frequencies with original timestamps retained; exact original M21 bins only for N=L.
findings.validation: Independent accepted-global-jitter, single retained frame with tail and shifted-origin/time precision regressions; direct DFT and raw centers/tail comparisons.

findings.problem: Unit-grid intermediate PSD and premature raw-magnitude squares can lose representable tiny density at low sample rate; Float64 underflow was not explicitly explained.
findings.correction: For N>L normalize magnitude before squaring with global fs/window power; preserve M21 bins only for N=L; report frame density/RMS and Welch-average representation limits.
findings.validation: Analytical subnormal low-fs regression and explicit frame/average underflow diagnostics; existing M21 bit-exact N=L cases.

findings.problem: PSD integrated-power prose could be read as division by L instead of sum of squared window weights.
findings.correction: State Σ[w²(x−μ)²]/Σw² per frame and arithmetic average over F.
findings.validation: Independent sample-domain Parseval and final documentation review.
